Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
